reason: 89 dollars a month is more than a fifth of what I earn in a whole year. Excel and Telegram cost me nothing and my people already know them.
objection: Moving my clients out of Excel and Telegram will take weeks, nobody does it for me, and I would pay 89 dollars a month for something I never paid for before.
would_change_my_mind: A price around 10 to 15 dollars a month, plus someone who moves my Excel data for free and shows my staff how to use it.
